name: edm
description: Enterprise Development Methodology — six-phase process (Planning → SRD → Audit → Tickets → Audit → Implementation) with HITL gates, parallel agent waves, automatic QC, and 11-lens code audit. Produces source-controlled artifacts in the project's SRD/ directory.

srd_root.title: SRD output root directory
srd_root.description: Where EDM artifacts are written. The canonical layout places each initiative under a product subdirectory: {srd_root}/{PRODUCT}/{PREFIX}__{description}/ (legacy flat {srd_root}/{PREFIX}/ still works). The Scripps default is ./SRD.

srd_filename.title: SRD filename (inside the initiative directory)
srd_filename.description: Default is srd.md. Some teams prefer {PREFIX}_SRD.md to match older Scripps initiatives — set this to that exact string, but note the plugin won't substitute {PREFIX} into this value at runtime.

ticket_pack_dirname.title: Ticket pack directory name
ticket_pack_dirname.description: Subdirectory inside the initiative folder. Default is tickets.

prefix_format_hint.title: Prefix format hint
prefix_format_hint.description: Shown when prompting the user for an initiative prefix.

commit_state_file.title: Commit .edm-state.json to git
commit_state_file.description: If true (default), gate approvals and phase timestamps are visible in git history. Set to false for per-developer state.

human_hourly_rate_usd.title: Human developer hourly rate (USD)
human_hourly_rate_usd.description: Used by /edm:metrics --with-human-baseline (opt-in view; not shown by default -- default output is raw Claude cost/duration only) to compute an ESTIMATED human-baseline cost per phase for comparison against Claude API cost. Defaults to $150/hr (typical fully-loaded engineer cost in the US).

jira_project_key.title: Jira project key (optional)
jira_project_key.description: Used by /edm:push-jira when no project key is passed as argument. Leave empty to disable the default — /edm:push-jira will then require an explicit project key argument. Requires the Atlassian MCP server to be connected.

jira_mcp_namespace.title: Jira MCP server namespace
jira_mcp_namespace.description: The MCP server namespace prefix for Jira tools. Default is 'plugin_jira_atlassian-mcp-server'. Change this if your Atlassian MCP server is registered under a different namespace (e.g., 'MCP_DOCKER' for legacy Docker-based installs).

coverage_target_unit_pct.title: Unit test coverage target (%)
coverage_target_unit_pct.description: Minimum acceptable unit test coverage percentage. The edm-test-coverage-auditor raises a P1 finding if coverage falls below this threshold.

coverage_target_component_pct.title: Component test coverage target (%)
coverage_target_component_pct.description: Minimum acceptable component test coverage percentage (React Testing Library, Vue Test Utils, etc.).

coverage_target_integration_pct.title: Integration test coverage target (%)
coverage_target_integration_pct.description: Minimum acceptable integration test coverage percentage.

coverage_target_e2e_critical_paths_pct.title: E2E coverage target for critical paths (%)
coverage_target_e2e_critical_paths_pct.description: Target percentage of identified critical user paths that must have E2E test coverage.

test_framework_unit_override.title: Unit test framework override
test_framework_unit_override.description: Pin the unit test framework when auto-detection is ambiguous (e.g., 'jest' or 'vitest' when both are installed, 'pytest' for Python). Leave empty for auto-detection.

test_framework_component_override.title: Component test framework override
test_framework_component_override.description: Pin the component test framework (e.g., '@testing-library/react', 'vue-test-utils'). Leave empty for auto-detection.

test_framework_e2e_override.title: E2E test framework override
test_framework_e2e_override.description: Pin the E2E test framework (e.g., 'playwright', 'cypress'). Leave empty for auto-detection.

mode.title: Initiative mode
mode.description: Default initiative mode for new initiatives. One of: standard, mini-srd, iac, data-ml, prototype. Standard runs all six phases. mini-srd skips Phase 2 SRD creation. iac and data-ml activate domain-specific agent configurations. prototype skips the code-audit convergence check.

compliance_enabled.title: Compliance enforcement
compliance_enabled.description: When true, the orchestrator enforces compliance checkpoints (regulatory, security, audit trail). Raises audit findings to P0 for any compliance gap. Default false — enable only in regulated environments.

qc_shard_threshold.title: QC sharding threshold (ticket count)
qc_shard_threshold.description: When a Phase 6 wave has more than this many tickets, QC spawns multiple edm-qc-auditor shards (at most 12 tickets each) and writes per-shard reports to {initiative-dir}/qc/. Set to a large value (e.g., 999) to always use single-auditor mode.

implementation_mode.title: Phase 6 implementation mode
implementation_mode.description: Controls the Phase 6 implementation strategy. 'standard' runs all tickets in parallel waves (default). 'tdd' enforces Red-Green-Refactor per ticket: failing tests must be committed before implementation code.
